records.name: Giles Rinse
records.biography_en: Giles Rinse works the Wash Detail with The Rinse Shift. When a player leaves another HyperNorm block in pieces, the crew returns with familiar tools and a fresh estimate. Giles Rinse takes pride in leaving one small part of the district easier to live in.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Giles Rinse has seen this corner before. The building was facing another direction then.
